{{Top|leg}}
'''Taerab Starship Manufacturing''' was a company that built [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]], they were rumored to have been developing a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] prototype that would cut fuel costs in half.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Discount Travel Plan}}</ref>
